in_marathi.name: Sharvikman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power and Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvikman is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words 'Sharva' and 'Kman'. Sharva is a name of Lord Shiva, the god of power, destruction, and regeneration. Kman means 'man', 'being', or 'person'. Together, Sharvikman can be interpreted as 'god of power and victory', 'powerful being', or 'victorious person'.
